scope: Six official Paddle formula ONNX exports; this is an evidence index, not a new benchmark run.

backendStatus.boundary: These are string-level diagnostic metrics; they are not TeX semantic equivalence, mathematical correctness, a held-out guarantee, or a release quality pass. Training overlap is unknown.

All six exact exports remain blocked in isolated processes: five FormulaNet graphs fail Loop-18 canonical-input/import validation and UniMERNet aborts the model-reader process. No formula quality result was produced.
The six exact batch=2 dynamic exports hit DS-OCV-8002 importer/input-specialization errors. This does not make a batch=1 or another OpenCV build implicitly supported.

No six-model formula TensorRT quality or performance matrix is available. The Plus-S TRT10.11 exact graph terminates during parser startup; TRT11 diagnostic rewrites can parse but return an empty Engine on shape-changing Loop recurrence. No derived graph reached Decoder; do not infer support from other PP-Structure TensorRT evidence.

knownQualityRisks.issue: One realFormula sample did not emit EOS before the 1,024-step export ceiling; the official Paddle IR and ONNX Loop share that ceiling and extending it exceeds the learned positional table.
High exact-match/CER on realFormula means the single-image smoke examples must not be used as accuracy claims; canonicalization and model/data suitability remain open.
